baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive قُتِلَ at word 2, interrogative كَيْفَ at word 3, and deliberate قَدَّرَ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lethal branch gives the passive a death-sentence force, while deliberate estimation identifies the condemned object as a worked-out design; كَيْفَ turns the line into astonished indictment rather than neutral description.

activation_trace.role: Killing and removal of life supply the surface force of a death-like passive verdict against the estimator.
Arrangement by estimate and deliberation makes the target a consciously engineered judgment.

changed_reading.before: Then he was killed; how he estimated.
changed_reading.after: Then a death-form verdict falls on him precisely for the design he deliberately arranged: how could he have constructed it so?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collision of passive قُتِلَ with the agentive intensive قَدَّرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subduing branch of ق ت ل breaks the force of a calculation imagined to confer effective control. The interrogative exposes the distance between claimed capacity and actual helplessness.

activation_trace.role: Subduing until force softens supplies humiliation and functionally collapses the planner's hardness.
Capacity reaching effective control supplies the mastery that the passive verdict overturns.

changed_reading.before: The line merely curses a bad planner.
changed_reading.after: The line stages a claim to calculated control being forcibly abased: what effective power did his measuring actually achieve?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rare mastery branch available to قُتِلَ at word 2 beside measured extent in قَدَّرَ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without treating mastery as the direct gloss of this passive form, the branch creates an ironic collision: the person who tries to comprehend and delimit the matter is himself comprehensively exposed by the verdict.

activation_trace.role: Complete mastery of a fact supplies an ironic counter-mastery that turns back upon the would-be master.
Measure reaching a thing's extent supplies the attempted delimitation that is itself delimited and exposed.

changed_reading.after: He tried to master the matter by measuring its extent, but the repeated verdict masters and exposes the estimator instead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening commission rises, warns, and magnifies the Lord, whereas the later deliberative sequence culminates in self-magnification. The focus becomes the hinge where Lord-directed action is replaced by a self-authorizing procedure and then subdued.

activation_trace.role: Subduing and softening force make the focus verdict the collapse of a rival posture.
Deliberative arrangement supplies the rival procedure positioned against the opening commission.
Resolute rising into a task supplies the commissioned mode of action that contrasts with seated calculation.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the outward purpose of the opening action.
Lordship and sovereignty establish the proper center toward which magnification is directed.
Greatness supplies commanded magnification of the Lord in the opening sequence.
Greatness recurs as self-exaltation, reversing the earlier orientation of the same root.

structural_cues: 74:2-7 forms an imperative chain, while 74:18-24 forms a deliberative ثُمَّ-chain ending in speech.
The root ك ب ر is directed toward رَبَّكَ in 74:3 but reflexively appropriated in ٱسْتَكْبَرَ at 74:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the rise-warning-Lord-magnification chain and the later self-magnification; I infer that their lexical and sequential contrast makes 74:20 the hinge between opposed procedures. A live alternative is a broad framing contrast without a tightly designed antithetical sequence.

changed_reading.before: A curse on one isolated act of calculation.
changed_reading.after: A hinge condemning a rival formation: commissioned warning magnifies the Lord, while his calculated sequence ends by magnifying himself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extended provision feeds a desire for further increase, then reverses into an imposed burdensome ascent. The narrowing branch of ق د ر and subduing branch of ق ت ل recast the focus as the point where acquisitive scaling produces its own constriction.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing to a scant measure supplies the reversal from expansive appetite to constriction.
Subduing until force softens supplies the collapse produced by that reversal.
Continuous extension supplies the initial material horizon of seemingly unbounded increase.
The heart's covetous hope turns received extension into an appetite for more.
Increase and growth name the direction the estimator keeps trying to impose.
A burdensome imposition reverses desired accumulation into pressure borne by the subject.
The arduous ascent gives the reversal a spatial mechanism of tightening effort.

structural_cues: 74:12-15 moves from extended wealth to wanting an increase; 74:17 reverses that trajectory into imposed ascent immediately before the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extension, appetite, increase, burden, and ascent; I infer a causal reversal in which acquisitive estimation narrows the estimator. A live alternative is that قَدَّرَ concerns only rhetorical plotting and does not inherit the earlier material economy.

changed_reading.before: The condemned calculation is cleverness detached from motive.
changed_reading.after: The calculation is acquisitive scaling: the one who keeps measuring toward more is measured down into burden and constriction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Thought recurs over the matter, estimation follows, and then both the estimate and its verdict are repeated across 74:19-20. The second قُتِلَ is not empty duplication: it makes the judgment track and dismantle each pass of the engineered claim.

activation_trace.role: The lethal verdict supplies the repeated counterstroke against the deliberative process.
Deliberative arrangement supplies the repeated object against which the counterstroke lands.
The heart's recurrent movement through a matter supplies an iterative cognitive process rather than a flash of opinion.
The first explicit arrangement links recurrent thought to a fabricated judgment.
The repeated arrangement keeps the designed act present under the first verdict.
The first lethal-form verdict establishes the paired stroke that 74:20 repeats with ثُمَّ.

structural_cues: 74:18 gives فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ; 74:19 and 74:20 repeat قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ, with فَـ then ثُمَّ marking successive relations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and changing conjunctions; I infer that the second verdict answers a renewed or more deeply exposed pass of calculation. A live alternative is pure rhetorical intensification with no temporal iteration.

changed_reading.before: The second line repeats a single curse for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: Every pass of the deliberative fabrication meets a corresponding death-form verdict, so the repetition enacts dismantling rather than merely reporting it.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, the estimate passes through directed looking, facial contraction, bodily turning, and spoken classification as transmitted deception. This makes قَدَّرَ a production pipeline in which a private design is rehearsed in the body and released as public speech.

activation_trace.role: Arrangement by estimate supplies the internal design that subsequent gestures and speech externalize.
Subduing force marks the designed performance as already defeated before it reaches speech.
Directed sight or insight supplies the first observable stage of testing the design.
Facial contraction from pressure gives the internal calculation a visible bodily output.
Turning the back converts internal resistance into enacted withdrawal.
Uttered speech is the release point at which the designed classification becomes public.
Diversion and deception supply the category into which the speaker tries to force the sign.
Transmitted report supplies the claim that reduces the sign to inherited human material.

structural_cues: The repeated ثُمَّ clauses after 74:20 move through gaze, face, posture, and finally speech in 74:21-24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered bodily and verbal outputs; I infer that they are stages by which the prior estimate is rehearsed and published. A live alternative is a simple narrative sequence in which the gestures express distress but do not help manufacture the claim.

changed_reading.before: قَدَّرَ names a completed private conclusion.
changed_reading.after: قَدَّرَ initiates a staged manufacture: the conclusion is tested in sight, written onto the face and posture, then issued as a public label.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ensuing fire-contact neither preserves a remainder nor leaves its object and visibly alters the human surface. Against that process, the doubled lethal wording in 74:19-20 sounds less like one terminal event and more like successive unmaking without release.

activation_trace.role: Killing and removal of life supply the terminal expectation that the later process complicates.
Leaving something alone supplies the release that the negated clause refuses.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the continuing medium of the unmaking.
A remainder supplies precisely what the negation denies can persist.
Heat that changes color gives the repeated verdict a visible, ongoing effect on the human surface.

structural_cues: 74:26-29 follows the doubled verdict with fire-contact, the paired negations لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ, and an effect on البشر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated lethal wording and a later no-remainder/no-release process; I infer a resonance of iterative unmaking across them. A live alternative is that قُتِلَ remains only an imprecation and should not be temporally mapped onto Sakar's action.

changed_reading.before: The passive describes or invokes one completed killing.
changed_reading.after: The doubled death-form verdict anticipates an ongoing stripping that neither resolves into a preserved remainder nor grants release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The estimator's attempt to master by measure is answered by an exact count whose declared function is testing, not passive information: it differentiates certainty from doubt while the full host remains known only to God. The measured claim is defeated by a counter-measure it cannot epistemically control.

activation_trace.role: Complete mastery of a fact supplies the ironic pretension that recoils onto the estimator.
Measure reaching an extent supplies the human attempt to delimit and control the sign.
Enumeration supplies a precise divine counter-measure rather than the man's improvised estimate.
Assaying metal or persons makes the count function as a discriminator of readers.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies one product of the assay.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrasting epistemic product of the same measure.
Disclosure to the knower establishes the knowledge that human enumeration does not exhaust.
A mutually supporting host supplies the unmastered total reserved beyond the stated count.

structural_cues: 74:30 states nineteen; 74:31 immediately names their number as a trial and narrates divergent certainty, increase, doubt, and questioning.
The same ayah closes the numerical discussion by restricting knowledge of the Lord's hosts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact number, its assay function, divergent epistemic effects, and restricted knowledge; I infer that this deliberately counters the man's قَدَّرَ. A live alternative is that the count only specifies guardians and does not answer his measuring lexically.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns one failed private calculation.
changed_reading.after: The focus condemns epistemic sovereignty: his attempt to master measure is answered by a measure designed to test the measurer and reveal what his calculation cannot contain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later choice to advance or delay leads directly to every self being held as security by what it acquires. This turns the focus calculation from an external opinion into an exercised capacity that produces a lien on its own agent; the subduing verdict names capture by the act he made.

activation_trace.role: Capacity reaching effective action supplies the agency by which the estimate becomes morally operative.
Subduing until force softens supplies the capture produced by the agent's own act.
Advancing forward supplies one direction in which human capacity can become action.
Delaying or falling later supplies the opposed direction of exercised choice.
The thing's own self or identity makes the calculator, not merely his proposition, the bearer of consequence.
Seeking and obtaining an acquisition makes the designed claim an act the self has gained to itself.
Security held against a right supplies the lien by which the acquisition captures its maker.

structural_cues: 74:37 presents advancing or delaying as live directions; 74:38 immediately binds each self to what it acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directional choice followed by self, acquisition, and pledge; I infer that the estimate in 74:20 is one such self-binding acquisition. A live alternative is that 74:38 states only a general rule and does not specifically characterize this estimator's act.

changed_reading.before: His estimate is a detachable opinion that happens to receive punishment.
changed_reading.after: His estimate is an acquired act that writes its own claim against him; the one who sought control becomes held by what he made.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah identifies itself as warning and reminder, preserves a response of willing within divine willing, and ends with protection and forgiveness. That communicative frame weakens a flat report of completed physical death and strengthens قُتِلَ as a lethal-form condemnation meant to break pretension while response remains possible.

activation_trace.role: Literal killing supplies the maximal terminal reading that the warning frame qualifies.
Warning that frightens into caution gives the condemnation a prospective communicative function.
Willing directed toward a thing preserves the hearer's possible response to the reminder.
A reminder that causes recollection frames the severe wording as an intervention in attention.
Protection that repels harm keeps open a relation other than terminal destruction.
Covering a fault while protecting its bearer from its effect supplies the closing possibility that qualifies finality.

structural_cues: 74:36 calls the discourse a warning; 74:54 calls it a reminder; 74:55-56 closes with willing, protection, and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, reminder, responsive willing, protection, and forgiveness; I infer that قُتِلَ functions primarily as corrective imprecation inside that address. A live alternative is that an open warning frame can still contain a purely terminal curse on this particular figure.

changed_reading.before: 74:20 reports or predicts an irreversible physical death.
changed_reading.after: 74:20 delivers a death-form condemnation that crushes the calculator's pretension inside a warning economy where recollection, protection, and forgiveness remain speakable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 'killer of winters' branch is an idiom associated with feeding and warming and is form-distant from passive قُتِلَ. It remains root-anchored and is sharply activated by the later admission of not feeding the humiliated poor. Downstream prose should present it only as an ironic lexical anti-title, never as a translation of 74:20.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُتِلَ at word 2 through the ق ت ل branch that names one who defeats winter by feeding and warming people.

activation_trace.role: The benefactor who 'kills winters' by feeding and warming supplies the ironic title denied by the later social failure.
Feeding another supplies the exact benefaction the speakers admit they did not perform.
The humiliation of poverty identifies the vulnerable recipient abandoned by the anti-benefactor.

changed_reading.before: قُتِلَ carries only destruction directed at the estimator.
changed_reading.after: An ironic anti-epithet shadows the verdict: far from one who 'kills winter' through care, this calculated posture belongs to the path that withholds food from the humiliated poor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links an intellectual verb to a later animal-flight scene and uses the exposure-to-killing branch rather than the ordinary passive-killing sense. It remains anchored in قَدَّرَ as deliberate arrangement and قُتِلَ as exposure, with an explicit sequence of turning away, bolting, fleeing, and pursuit. Downstream prose should mark it as a behavioral analogy, not identify the planner literally with the depicted animals.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The deliberate قَدَّرَ at word 4 beside قُتِلَ at word 2 through the branch of being made liable to killing.

activation_trace.role: Exposure to being killed supplies the planner's self-placement in the vulnerable position of quarry.
Deliberative arrangement supplies the analytical behavior reclassified as an elaborate evasion.
Turning one's side away supplies the initial conversion of engagement into evasion.
Recoiling and distancing supply the sudden bodily logic hidden beneath the calculation.
Flight makes explicit that the apparent analysis can function as escape from reminder.
The pursuing force completes the quarry relation activated by exposure to killing.

changed_reading.before: The estimator remains a composed analyst who simply reaches the wrong answer.
changed_reading.after: His elaborate estimate can be heard as flight disguised as analysis: turning from reminder places the calculating subject in the position of quarry before a pursuing force.

strongest_changes: The adjacent repetition makes 74:20 an enacted second dismantling of a recurrent deliberative process, not a redundant curse.
The opening commission and later self-magnification turn the focus into a hinge between Lord-directed warning and self-authorizing manufacture.
The numbered trial in 74:30-31 answers human قَدَّرَ with a measure that tests the measurer, sorting certainty from doubt under knowledge reserved to God.
The closing warning-reminder-protection frame weakens a flat report of physical death in favor of a corrective death-form condemnation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two branch-rich roots repeatedly reverse one another: measure seeks mastery, while قُتِلَ kills, subdues, or ironically masters that mastery. Context turns the four-word line into a hinge among acquisitive motive, staged rhetoric, epistemic testing, and self-binding consequence without forcing those readings into one final sense.
remaining_uncertainties: ثُمَّ may mark a renewed deliberative pass, a rank escalation, or only rhetorical intensification.
The balance among literal killing, imprecation, and humiliation remains unresolved because the passive supplies no explicit agent in the focus line.
The 'killer of winters' and quarry readings are branch-distant resonances and must remain exploratory rather than lexical glosses.
